name: Tolly
official_context: A character using a timer circuit and red-yellow-green LED sequence.
verified_facts: Tolly uses a timer circuit and a red-yellow-green LED sequence.
Tolly demonstrates electronic sequencing through repeating light patterns.
Tolly connects real-world electronics like traffic lights to circuit connections.

learning_materials.beginner: Tolly lights up LEDs in red, yellow, and green order just like real traffic signals!
learning_materials.intermediate: Tolly's timer circuit regulates electricity flow to trigger each LED in a timed sequence.
learning_materials.advanced: Timer circuits control frequency and duty cycles to cycle through LED states predictably.
